health.note: Vanilla health: 10 hearts at level 1, +1 heart every 6 levels (level 60: 19 hearts). Clan and gear hearts stack on top.

toughness.note: Incoming damage to the player is divided by 1 + 0.025 x (level - 1): a level-50 body takes 45% of what a level-1 body takes from the same blow, so hearts stay readable while enemies scale.

chakra.note: A bar beside hunger. Regenerates slowly, faster meditating (sneak and stand still), from soldier pills and some food. Casting short of chakra (by at most 25% of the cost) is a desperate cast: the shortfall is paid in health at 0.5 HP per point and leaves you exhausted.

control.note: Chakra control, 0 to 100. Lowers chakra cost (x1.15 at 0, x0.85 at 100), speeds hand signs (4 ticks a sign, 3 from 80), stretches chakra movement and gates medical and precision techniques. Grows through training, not levels.

stamina.note: Taijutsu and weapons run on stamina, ninjutsu on chakra. Stamina refills in about three seconds, so a close-range fighter is limited by footwork and timing, never by a slow bar. A guard that runs out of stamina breaks (staggered for 20 ticks).

poise.note: Hidden toughness bar on every fighter. Every hit carries poise damage; at 0 the target staggers (16 ticks, interrupts any cast) and poise refills. Heavies, launchers, blunt weapons and earth hit poise hard; Strong Fist and Akimichi build it up.

momentum.note: Builds as you land hits and parries without being hit; taijutsu and weapon finishers spend it. Momentum is the close-range pillar's answer to a full chakra bar: big finishers that cost no chakra.

chakra_exhaustion.trigger: chakra reaches 0 or a desperate cast

exhaustion.fatigue_link: Shinobi Life's fatigue writes stat modifiers (movement, damage, chakra regen); Combat reads chakra regen and the movement and damage attributes.
